hints.title: Lexicographical Greedy Principle
hints.text: To produce the smallest possible string, output the smallest available character at every opportunity.

hints.title: Suffix Minimum Lookahead
hints.text: Precompute min_suffix[i], which stores the smallest character in the remaining suffix s[i..].

hints.title: Stack Drain Trigger
hints.text: Push characters onto stack t. Whenever the top of t is less than or equal to the minimum remaining character in s, greedily pop it to the paper.

hints.title: Stack Output Greedy Drain Implementation

complexity.notes: Each character is pushed and popped from stack t at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive branching over push and pop decisions yields exponential runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for suffix array and buffer stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses greedy stack popping driven by precomputed suffix minimums.
